instruction: Set up LibreOffice Impress to display animations during slide transitions in presentation mode.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling animations in presentation settings (Tools > Options > LibreOffice Impress > General). Evaluator checks the EnableAnimations configuration setting. Verified by checking LibreOffice configuration schema.
metadata.verification_method: Configuration file structure verified by reading existing check_presenter_console_disable function and LibreOffice registry XML schema

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks EnableAnimations setting in LibreOffice config file at the appropriate XML path
Metric logic properly parses XML with namespace handling and performs case-insensitive comparison
Expected value 'true' correctly matches the requirement to enable animations
Coverage is complete - single requirement (enable animations) is fully verified
Getter can successfully extract the config file from VM
Minor concern: No postconfig to ensure settings dialog is closed before verification, but LibreOffice typically auto-saves settings changes to registrymodifications.xcu
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding a postconfig step to close any open settings dialogs (e.g., press Escape or click OK) to ensure settings are flushed to disk before verification

The instruction phrase 'animations during slide transitions' could be clarified - it currently checks EnableAnimations which controls whether slide animations play during presentations, not transition effects between slides
